newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light mid-protein trade.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light mid-protein trade.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light nearby activity in mid-protein products this afternoon, while soymeal was neglected, dealers said.

"Buyers were not willing to pay the higher prices for South American soymeal on the back of Monday's higher Chicago soymeal futures close. Calls for a weaker Chicago opening added to the lack of interest. Instead buyers looked at the relatively cheaper mid-protein products to cover their needs," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $138 a tonne cif Rotterdam and July/Sept at $141 a tonne cif.
Arrived citruspulp pellets changed hands at $104 and April at $108 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
EU rapemeal traded at 32.75 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine for week 16 delivery, May at 31.75 and June/midJuly at 31 marks.
Jan/June 1998 Thai hard tapioca pellets traded at 20 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
